ModMetaData.name: Prisoner Diplomacy: Example Add-on
ModMetaData.author: g1061
ModMetaData.description: A playable, source-included SDK example compatible with Prisoner Diplomacy 1.2.1 and its public API 1.2. Adds two special rewards and demonstrates context adapters, faction personas, event metadata, read-only snapshots, demand previews, UI extensions, diagnostics, localization, and safe failure boundaries. Requires Prisoner Diplomacy.
